resources.string: From each part’s source, with explicit zone and precision. Unknown times stay unknown; separate from mm:ss timestamps.
Each collection preserves associated material and the included recording sessions. Open files by title and date; long recordings are split into pieces.

Only selected sessions are included. Associated text, tags, metadata and sources are preserved from their backing collection; its other recordings are excluded. Originals that may contain other audio remain as metadata without an attachment.
The selected text has no associated timings: part origins are not speech times attributed to its sentences.

Clock times use each part’s own start plus its part-relative offset, with an explicit zone or offset. Date-only values, minute precision and unknown zones remain qualified; session timestamps exclude gaps between files.
